parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg part of the pliers, made of steel. It includes one of the gripping arms and the handle section.
parts.Functional_description: The leg provides leverage and transmits force from the handle to the jaws for gripping or cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of steel, forming the main structure that connects both legs and includes the pivot joint.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the central connecting and pivoting structure, allowing the two legs to move in opposition for gripping or cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary while allowing rotational movement of the legs around the pivot axis.
